all_domain_empirical_predictions.blocker: All-domain readiness requires held-out or target-blind numeric evidence for every required domain. Partial target-blind support cannot certify all-domain readiness.

mathematics_formal_support.blocker: Mathematics readiness closes through the formal route only: theorem IDs, proof sheets, Lean refs, finite cases, formal support references, and zero critical/high formal blockers. It must not count as empirical grand evidence.

claim_boundary_no_overclaim.scan_policy: Blocks unsupported TOE, all-domain prediction, irrefutability, final truth, and actual send-readiness claims unless context explicitly negates or owner-gates them.

journal_send_readiness_minus_owner_lock.blocker: Journal packages may be owner-review-ready, but actual send readiness remains locked until owner approval and scientific all-domain evidence pass.
